environments.name: dev
environments.purpose: Development and integration testing by engineers, including feature branches deployed as short-lived revisions.
environments.hosting: Azure Container Apps environment in Central India (Pune); ingress public IP 198.51.100.60, VNet 10.60.0.0/16
environments.access_control: Engineering staff via Entra ID SSO group readmeforge-dev with Contributor rights; not reachable by customers.
environments.notes: Uses a small PostgreSQL instance and a GitHub App registered against test repositories only; data may be wiped at any time.

environments.name: staging
environments.purpose: Pre-production verification of each release, including the weekly release candidate, smoke tests and canary checks before production rollout.
environments.hosting: Azure Container Apps environment in Central India (Pune); ingress public IP 203.0.113.50, VNet 10.50.0.0/16
environments.access_control: Engineering and QA via Entra ID SSO group readmeforge-staging; deployments only through the release pipeline.
environments.notes: First location in the rollout order; configuration mirrors production. Contains no customer data.

environments.name: prod-central-india
environments.purpose: Production location in Central India (Pune) serving customers and hosting the primary write database.
environments.hosting: Azure Container Apps environment in Central India (Pune); ingress public IP 203.0.113.10, VNet 10.10.0.0/16
environments.access_control: Read-only for on-call and application support engineers via Azure RBAC and just-in-time elevation (Privileged Identity Management); changes only through the release pipeline. Customers reach it through Azure Front Door only.
environments.notes: Primary write region for PostgreSQL. Second in the rollout order.

environments.name: prod-south-india
environments.purpose: Production location in South India (Chennai) serving customers and acting as the disaster-recovery region.
environments.hosting: Azure Container Apps environment in South India (Chennai); ingress public IP 203.0.113.20, VNet 10.20.0.0/16
environments.access_control: Read-only for on-call and application support engineers via Azure RBAC and just-in-time elevation (Privileged Identity Management); changes only through the release pipeline. Customers reach it through Azure Front Door only.
environments.notes: Paired disaster-recovery and geo-backup region; promoted to primary write region during a regional failure of Central India. Third in the rollout order.

environments.name: prod-west-india
environments.purpose: Production location in West India (Mumbai) serving customers.
environments.hosting: Azure Container Apps environment in West India (Mumbai); ingress public IP 198.51.100.30, VNet 10.30.0.0/16
environments.access_control: Read-only for on-call and application support engineers via Azure RBAC and just-in-time elevation (Privileged Identity Management); changes only through the release pipeline. Customers reach it through Azure Front Door only.

environments.name: prod-jio-west
environments.purpose: Production location in Jio India West (Jamnagar) serving customers.
environments.hosting: Azure Container Apps environment in Jio India West (Jamnagar); ingress public IP 198.51.100.40, VNet 10.40.0.0/16
environments.access_control: Read-only for on-call and application support engineers via Azure RBAC and just-in-time elevation (Privileged Identity Management); changes only through the release pipeline. Customers reach it through Azure Front Door only.

notes: All environments run on Azure in India only, keeping data resident in India. Global traffic enters through Azure Front Door (https://app.readmeforge.example, API at https://api.readmeforge.example) with WAF enabled, which routes to the nearest healthy production location. Dev and staging are both in Central India.
